guidebook.intro: Yogera ku bwakabaka bwa Buganda mu Lungereza: Kabaka, Lukiiko, Bulange n’amasiro.

tips.title: Enukuta enene ku bitiibwa
body: Amanya g’abantu, ebifo n’ebitiibwa gatandika n’enukuta enene: **the Kabaka**, **the Queen**, **His Majesty**, **Buganda**, **Mengo**.
Ku Kabaka oteeka **the**: **The Kabaka rules Buganda.**

tips.title: Ebyafaayo
body: Okunyonyola ebyafaayo, kozesa ebikolwa by’ebyayita: **Very long ago, Kintu was the first Kabaka.** Ku bintu ebikyaliwo atyanu kozesa **is**: **The kingdom of Buganda is very old.**

culture.title: Amasiro g’e Kasubi
body: Amasiro g’e Kasubi gamanyikidwa mu nsi yona: **The Kasubi Tombs are a World Heritage Site.** Abalambuzi bangi badha okugalaba.
